title: Cold water inshore of the East Australian Current
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 daily near-surface temperature for 1993-2020 in the western Tasman Sea off south-eastern Australia (46-26 S, 147-162 E), determine where and when cold water appears at the surface inshore of the East Australian Current, how often and how strongly, how these events vary along the coast, by season and from year to year, and what the patterns suggest about their causes. Winds are not supplied.

region.name: Tasman Sea and East Australian Current
